text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of anything on its own. In many ministries women are a majority of senior staff, so such panels occur by chance; the composition tells you nothing about how they scored you. Raising it would read as an accusation you cannot support, and would overshadow your legitimate complaint.

Your real grievance is the unanswered request. Chase it in writing, citing the deadline for a reasoned decision under your jurisdiction's administrative or civil-service rules, and ask for the scoring criteria, your scores and the appointee's relative scores against those criteria.

If the scores show your stronger formal qualifications were disregarded without a documented justification, you then have something concrete — procedure, not panel sex.
